title: Edge runtime vs Node runtime
description: Learn about Edge runtime vs Node runtime. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **Edge runtime vs Node runtime** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with edge runtime vs node runtime.

items: Understand the core differences between edge runtime and node runtime
Know when to choose edge runtime over node runtime
Recognize the trade-offs involved in each approach
Apply the right tool for the specific problem context

data.text: Understanding edge runtime vs node runtime is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: When working with edge runtime vs node runtime, always consider the trade-offs. The right approach depends on your specific context, team expertise, and system requirements.

items.text: Use Edge for fast, simple responses near users
Use Node for heavy computation or native dependencies
Avoid Node-only APIs in Edge routes
Measure cold-start and latency before choosing
